experiment_data.hypothesis: TOST equivalence conclusions are robust across random seeds: bootstrap resampling (n=1000 iterations) of TOST p-values on stationary features yields consistent rejection of non-equivalence (p < 0.05 in >95% of bootstrap samples), strengthening the shape-feature stationarity claim
experiment_data.notes: Dry-run (n=10) 验证通过。entropy_std |d|=0.46 > margin, TOST 不拒绝（符合预期 "intermediate"）。entropy_max/min/tail_decay 100% rejection。纯 CPU ~2min。命令: python3 scripts/tost_bootstrap.py --n-bootstrap 1000 --base-seed 42 --output results/tost_bootstrap.json
